exposure: components of the Birth Satisfaction Scale - Revised (BSS-R) (staff support, parturient confidence, distress during labour)
outcome: Validity of the Igbo version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale - Revised (BSS-R)
Reliability of the Igbo version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale - Revised (BSS-R)
Internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha) of the Igbo version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale - Revised (BSS-R)
Component structure of the Igbo version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale - Revised (BSS-R)
cohort: 500 women who gave birth at the Alex Ekwueme Federal University Teaching hospital in Abakaliki, Nigeria, between March 1 and August 31, 2019.
finding: The Igbo version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale - Revised (BSS-R) demonstrated good internal consistency, making it a valid and reliable tool for assessing maternal satisfaction among Igbo-speaking women.
